summary: Implement transparent browser-automation fallback for reports create command when Concur v4 API rejects pure HTTP requests with policyId required error, including dismissal of a live-reproduced blocking interstitial dialog.
reason: Live Concur v4 API rejects report creation on some tenants with HTTP 400 policyId is required, because these tenants require explicit policy assignment, but the CLI does not expose any policy IDs to callers. Following the established template of hotels_search.go, this patch auto-detects specifically this error shape and transparently retries by driving a browser via agent-browser to submit the Create Report dialog. Amended same-day after a live end-to-end run surfaced a second, real bug in this same fallback: a one-time-per-session promotional interstitial dialog (observed: "We've updated the hotel booking experience.") can render on top of the Create Report modal on a fresh page load and silently block the Create Report click, leaving the command to time out waiting for the report page to appear. Fixed by mirroring hotels_search.go's existing overlay-clearing step (find a plain "close" button, click it), with an Escape-key fallback added after live testing showed the close-button click alone can report success without actually dismissing the dialog.

changes.description: Updated reports create execution path to catch 400 policyId validation error, transparently invoke agent-browser fallback, and retrieve the newly created report details. Amended same-day to dismiss a blocking interstitial dialog before the Create Report click: try a plain close-button click first (matching hotels_search.go's overlay-clearing convention), and fall back to Escape if a dialog is still detected afterward.

Mock-based unit tests covering: policyId required error triggering browser fallback, other 400 errors surfacing unchanged, successful HTTP creation never triggering browser fallback, an interstitial dialog dismissed by a single close-button click (with Escape asserted as NOT called), and an interstitial that survives the close-button click, requiring the Escape fallback (asserted as called) before the flow completes.

validated_outcome: Unit tests pass across all five scenarios (direct HTTP success, other HTTP 400 error, policyId-required browser fallback, interstitial dismissed by close click, interstitial requiring Escape fallback). Full module test suite (go test ./...) passes with zero regressions. Live end-to-end run same day: created a real report against the actual tenant via this exact fallback path, hit the interstitial bug live, diagnosed and fixed it live via direct agent-browser inspection (not simulated), then re-verified the fix against the unit-test harness described above.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generic auto-detect-and-fallback-to-browser for any printed CLI mutation that live-fails on a tenant-config-dependent required field the generator has no way to discover ahead of time (this instance: Concur's policyId on report creation).
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Only observed once so far (this concur-pp-cli instance). Kept CLI-specific rather than opening a cli-printing-press generator issue on a single data point; noting the pattern here so a second independent sighting has a paper trail to point back to before generalizing.
